blurb: `expect <call> faults` claims that an effectful call throws, for instance because a `stub … fails`. Only a call can fault, so the subject must be the call itself, with type `Effect[_]`. A value already bound, or a pure method on one, has nothing left to throw. Write the call inside the claim, not a name bound from it. A fault that is not claimed fails the case.
example:
// tests/vault.test.bynk
let label = "sealed"
expect label.length() faults   // ✗ a pure method, not an effectful call
expect box.call() faults       // ✓ the call that faults
summary: A fault claim's subject (`expect <call> faults`) is not an effectful call: a value, or a call whose type is not `Effect[_]`.
